captions.detailed: A modern, rectangular bread maker with a light gray matte plastic exterior and rounded corners. It features a raised, rear-hinged lid containing a dark viewing window on top, which opens upward to reveal a spacious inner baking chamber. On the front-slanted control deck, there is a black dial that rotates continuously alongside four rectangular, white-capped push buttons arranged in a neat row.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a family bread maker with a rectangular body, rounded vertical edges, and a hollow inner baking cavity. The unit must feature a rear-hinged opening lid with a viewing window, a continuously rotating selector dial, and four prismatic push buttons on the front control panel.
captions.factory: Construct the main body from a rounded box, then shell or subtract a smaller box to create the open baking chamber. Model the lid as a separate rounded box with a subtracted center filled by a thin window pane. Create the control panel by pocketing a sloped recess, then place a cylindrical selector dial and four small extruded rectangular push buttons inside it.
